title: DVA-C03: read the symptom before you pick the fix

questions.ask: Every call times out right after the function joined a VPC?
questions.yes: No route out: add a NAT gateway or VPC endpoints

questions.ask: Immediate AccessDeniedException on KMS although IAM allows it?
questions.yes: The key policy does not let IAM policies grant access

questions.ask: 429 or throttles while the account limit is unused?
questions.yes: The function's own reserved concurrency is the cap
API Gateway's integration timeout: make it asynchronous

questions.ask: "Too many connections" on RDS during spikes?
questions.yes: Each Lambda environment holds a connection: use RDS Proxy

otherwise: Instant failure: check policies. Failure at exactly the timeout: routes or a slow dependency.

caption: Match the symptom from the top before reading the options; the tempting wrong fix usually belongs to a different symptom.
